criteria: network-perceptron.html is one self-contained interactive single-layer perceptron demo: a 2D point plane with a live decision boundary shown next to a perceptron diagram (inputs, weights, bias, output) with both visible at once, start/pause/step/reset controls, live weights/bias/epoch/accuracy, random datasets, and a note on why one layer cannot solve XOR. No frameworks.

review.description: Interactive single-layer perceptron: 2D plane + live decision boundary next to a neuron diagram, train controls, live weights/bias/epoch/accuracy, random datasets, XOR note; fixed side-by-side layout.
